_comment: PUBLISHED-TARGET for DeepSeek-V4-PRO (the 1.6T / 49B-activated model), SNC-corrected like the Flash artifact. Pro decode is weight-streaming bound and near-saturated (batching buys little): model-roofline-analysis worked example gives B=32 ~58 tok/s on the FULL 2-socket node; SNC-effective = x4/6 (TP=4 of 6 domains, heads not div by 6) -> ~38.7 tok/s. PRECISION NOTE: Pro exceeds the node in fp8 (experts 98% of the model; fp4->fp8 load-dequant ~1.58TB > 1.5TB, ~395GB/rank>>248GB/NUMA), so on CPU it runs fp4-STORAGE + bf16-COMPUTE (dequant-in-forward). That is the BF16 showcase for Pro; it is SLOW (torch dequant, no AMX) so the MEASURED will sit well below this memory-roofline until an AMX fp4/int8 expert kernel lands (the perf bonus). measured=null=PENDING until the real DSA+bf16 run (job 372733) completes; then regenerated by model-profile-hotspots at the SAME config. Contrast with deepseek_v4_flash_roofline.* (the 284B Flash, which fits all precisions and shows the bf16->fp8->int8 uplift).
node: gnr_6980p (SNC-on: 6 NUMA domains; TP=4 = 4/6 domains; effective 841/1261 GB/s)
